content: Ixaane Yarshiya Bessi
“Ixaane cuyisiya bessaa soqala mithafe medha.
Iyaw oyddu maazaney de7o. Adussatethaynne gompay issi issi wadha, geesay nam7u wadha gido. Oyddu maazaniyan de7iya kaceti iyara oyketidi oosetonna.
Iyaw bolla baggaa, iya oyddu maazanetanne iya kaceta walahi bayna worqan lanxa. Iya yuushuwaka worqan lanxa.
Nam7u worqa sagaayota oothada, xarpheeza tookanaw maaddiya kaso mithata aathanaw goossaas nam7u baggara oytha.
Kaso mithata soqala mithafe kessada, enta worqan lanxa.
He ixaane yarsho xarpheezaa, Caaqo Taabotiya sinthan kaqetida magarajuwafe kare baggara wotha. Yan taani neera gahetana.
“Aaroni wonta wonta xompeta giigisanaw yaa wode, sawiya ixaane yarshiya bessan cuyiso.
Hessada, Aaroni omarsi xompeta xompiya wodeka ixaane cuyiso. He ixaaniya yarshoy yaana laytha ubban Godaa sinthan cuyo.
Ha yarsho bessan hara digetida ixaane, katha yarsho, mehe yarshonne woyne yarsho yarshofa.

Aaroni, nagaraa atotethas laythafe issi toho shuketiya mehiya suuthaafe ekidi, he yarsho bessa maazaneta bolla de7iya kaceta wothidi geeshsho wogaa polo. Ha wogay sinthara yaana wode ubban laythan laythan poleto. He yarsho bessay geeshshi gidiya gisho Godaas dummatis” yaagis.
Nagara Atotetha Miishe
Hessafe guye, Goday Museko haysada yaagis;
“Neeni Isra7eele asaa taybiya wode, issi issi asi ba shempuwa wozanaw Godaas miishe qanxo. Yaatiko neeni enta taybiya wode gadoy enta bolla yeenna.
Taybon geliya asi oonika huuphen huuphen geeshsha dunkaanen eretida mizaane ginan bira ciggo. Issi issi asi hessa taw yarsho oothidi immo.
Taybon geliya asi oonika laythi laatamanne iyape bolla gidida ubbay Godaas hessa eho.
Enti banta shempuwa wozanaw Godaas imota immiya wode, dureyka manqoyka issi gina immofe attishin, durey darsidi woyko manqoy guuthidi immofo.
He miishiya Isra7eele asaape ekada, Geeshsha Dunkaaniya naaganaw peeshsha. He miishey enta shempuwa wozanawunne ta enta naagana mela qofisiyaba gidana” yaagis.
Meecha Kere
Goday Museko haysada yaagis;
“Meecha keriyanne iya tohuwa naase biratape medha. Iyan haathe tigada Geeshsha Dunkaaniyapenne yarsho bessaafe giddon wotha.
Aaroninne iya nayti banta kushiyanne banta tohuwa yan meeceto.
Enti Geeshsha Dunkaaniya gelanaapenne yarsho yarshanaape sinthe hessa oothanaw bessees. Hessa enti oothiko hayqope attoosona.
Enti hayqonna mela, banta kushiyanne banta tohuwa meecetanaw bessees. Hessi Aaronasinne iya sheeshatas, yaa yeletetha ubbaas merinaa woga gidana” yaagis.
Shuumatetha Zayte
Goday Museko haysada yaagis;
“Geeshsha sawota, hessatika; usupun kilo giraame gukiya karbe, heedzu kilo giraame sawiya qarafa, heedzu kilo giraame sawiya maata,
usupun kilo giraame burgude eka. He ubbayka geeshsha dunkaanen eretida mizaaniya gina gido. Hessata bolla oyddu litiro zayte guja.
Hessata shittoda walakada, sawiya geeshsha zayte oothada,
Geeshsha Dunkaaniyanne Caaqo Taabotiya tiya.
Xarpheezanne iya miisheta, xompe wothiya kocaanne iya miisheta, ixaane cuyisiya xarpheezaa,
xuussa yarsho bessinne iyan bolla de7iya miisheta ubba, meecha keriyanne iya tohuwa tiya.
Enti polo geeshshi gidana mela enta dummaya. Enta bochiya oonika geeshshi gidana.
“Hessafe guye, Aaroninne iya nayti kahine gididi taw haggaazana mela enta tiyada dummaya.
Isra7eele asaas, ‘Haysi Geeshsha shuumatetha zaytey yaa yeletethaas tana haggaazanaw maaddiya zayte gido.
He zaytiya coo asa bolla gussofa; qassi ay zayteka iya oothida ogiyan oothofa. Zaytey geeshshi gidida gisho, hinteka iya geeshshatetha erite.
He shittuwa giigisiya asi, woyko kahine gidonna hara asi tiyiya oonika ta asaa giddofe hileto’ yaaga” yaagis.
Ixaane
Goday Museko haysada yaagis; “Geeshsha sawota, xokiya mitha made, dhaadhe keethan de7iya shitto, sawiya madenne sawiya ixaane eka; enta ubbaa mizaaney issi gina gido.
Shittoda walahetida ixaane oothada enta go7eta. Walahi baynanne geeshshi gidana mela iyan maxine yegga.
Iyape guuthara ekada liiqisa caddada, taani neera gahetiya Geeshsha Dunkaaniya giddon, Caaqo Taabotiya sinthan wurxa. He ixaaney new polo geeshshi gido.
Hintew go7etanaw he ixaaniya ay ogenka giigisopite. Hessi taw dummatidaysa gideysa erite.
Hessatho oothidi, iya sawuwa singidi ufaytanaw koyiya oonika, ta asaa giddofe dhayana” yaagis.
